I’m not able to look up real‑time addresses directly from here, but I can walk you through some quick ways to find a great ice‑cream shop near you:

| Method | How it works |
|--------|--------------|
| **Search engines** | Type “ice cream shops near [your city]” into Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, etc. The results usually include a map bubble showing nearby options plus ratings & reviews. |
| **Map apps** | Use Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, or MapQuest. Search “ice cream,” then zoom in/out until you see the spots most convenient for your current location. Tap each pin for photos, hours, menus, and directions. |
| **Yelp / TripAdvisor** | These sites specialize in food listings. Filter by distance, rating (“5 stars”), price range, and read short customer comments before heading out. |
| **Social media** | Instagram stories tagged #IceCream + your city often reveal hidden gems. Facebook Marketplace sometimes lists local vendors too. |
| **Local guides** | Many cities publish free PDF guides or online articles titled “Best Ice Cream Spots.” Quick web searches will pull those up. |
| **Ask locals** | If you’re already at home or work, just ask coworkers, neighbors, or friends—personal recommendations tend to be reliable. |

### Quick step‑by‑step example (using Google Maps)

1. Open <https://maps.google.com> (or launch the app).
2. In the search bar type `ice cream`.
3. Press *Enter* – a list of places appears on the left; pins appear on the right side of the screen.
4. Click/tap a pin → view its photo gallery, opening times, phone number, website, and user reviews.
5. Choose the spot that looks good, tap *Directions*, and follow the route.

If you let me know what city or neighborhood you’re interested in, I could even recommend a few well‑rated names based on common knowledge!
